content.comment_body: I need some help again. I have a 24V DC [product_name] and need to power my relay output, a 24V DC coil, and a solenoid coil that draws 1.8A. Is the relay able to handle this load? Thanks.

Hello, the transistor outputs on [product_name] can support a maximum current of 0.3A. If your [product_name] uses relay outputs, the device itself handles a maximum load of 10A, while an expansion module supports up to 5A. For more details, refer to the [document]. Hope this information is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want clear guidance regarding the output current limits for relay and transistor outputs on [product_name] to ensure their 24V DC coil with a 1.8A requirement can be operated safely. The main usability challenge is a lack of accessible information about maximum supported loads for each output type, affecting user confidence and equipment protection.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to reliably handle output loads as defined by the official specifications and seek quick, straightforward answers about maximum current for relay and transistor outputs.
